title: Double-Slit as Grid-Resolution Phenomenon in Grid-Rendering Cosmology
abstract: Working note extending Grid-Rendering Cosmology (GRC) to the double-slit experiment with an exact ultraviolet (UV) cutoff formulation arising from a discrete grid scale lg. It derives the deviation from standard QM as an omitted high-k band and shows that for Gaussian slit profiles the deviation is exponentially suppressed, withdrawing a prior polynomial ansatz. The paper relocates testable distinctions to entropy-sensitive decoherence via a clarity function C(S) and to higher-order measurement statistics, noting an open gap in the operational definition of local entropy S.
